2610.13386.title: MoPrO-SD: Modular Prompt Optimization for Stance Detection
2610.13386.paper_summary: Stance detection remains challenging for large language models (LLMs) due to implicit opinions, sarcasm, and context-dependent expressions of stance. Although automatic prompt optimization offers an alternative to fine-tuning without updating model parameters, existing structured approaches are not specifically designed around stance-label semantics and class-specific ambiguities. We introduce MoPrO-SD, a stance-specific prompt optimization framework that decomposes prompts into functional semantic modules and refines them sequentially using LLM-based feedback. We study three refinement strategies: instruction-only optimization (I), instruction with reasoning (I+R), and instruction with per-example reasoning (I+R+E), using class-conditioned errors for stance-label refinement. We also introduce VaccineStance, a new human-annotated benchmark for vaccine stance detection. Experiments across four datasets and five open-weight LLMs show that MoPrO-SD improves upon the human-written Base prompt in many settings. On SemEval-2016, class-conditioned feedback achieves higher mean Macro-F1 than pooled feedback for four of five backbones. Both reasoning-based strategies, I+R and I+R+E, achieve strong performance, with their relative effectiveness varying across models and datasets, while remaining competitive with recent prompt optimization methods. The MoPrO-SD code and VaccineStance dataset are available on GitHub.
2610.13386.paper_summary_zh: 立場檢測對於大型語言模型（LLMs）來說仍然具有挑戰性，因為隱含的意見、諷刺和依賴上下文的立場表達。雖然自動提示優化提供了一種不更新模型參數的微調替代方案，但現有的結構化方法並不是專門針對立場標籤語義和類別特定的模糊性設計的。我們介紹了 MoPrO-SD，一個立場特定的提示優化框架，將提示分解為功能性語義模塊，並使用基於 LLM 的反饋進行順序精煉。我們研究了三種精煉策略：僅指令優化（I）、帶推理的指令（I+R）和每個示例的推理指令（I+R+E），使用類別條件錯誤來進行立場標籤的精煉。我們還介紹了 VaccineStance，一個新的人工標註疫苗立場檢測基準。在四個數據集和五個開放權重的 LLM 上進行的實驗顯示，MoPrO-SD 在許多設置中優於人類編寫的基本提示。在 SemEval-2016 中，類別條件反饋在五個骨幹中的四個上達到了比匯總反饋更高的平均 Macro-F1。兩種基於推理的策略 I+R 和 I+R+E 表現出色，其相對有效性在模型和數據集之間有所不同，同時與最近的提示優化方法保持競爭力。MoPrO-SD 的代碼和 VaccineStance 數據集可在 GitHub 上獲得。
